**Uncanny Likeness.** A creature that knows the person must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check to tell the plover's voice from the person's when it can't see who is speaking. The DC rises to 20 once the plover has been with its person for ten years.

sections.title: Traits
items: **Water Breathing.** The anemone can breathe only underwater.

**Home Tide.** The anemone opens at high tide and closes at low tide of the sea where it grew, wherever it is. Its keeper always knows the exact time of the next high and low tide there. Moved to a new sea, it takes a month to learn the new tide.

chartback-tortoise.name: Chartback Tortoise

sections.title: Traits
items: **Beast of Burden.** The tortoise counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.
**Long Haul.** The tortoise can go three weeks without food or water and suffer nothing worse than a bad mood.
**Measured Pace.** The tortoise knows exactly how many paces it has walked since it last finished a Long Rest, and from where. A keeper who reads its count knows the distance to the yard.
**Shell Retreat.** As a Bonus Action, the tortoise withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, its AC is 21, its Speed is 0, and it has Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.

notes: It makes no attacks.

lodge-hound.name: Lodge Hound

sections.title: Traits
items: **Keen Smell.** The hound has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

**Fearless.** The hound has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

notes: Unlike other companions, a lodge hound fights beside its Hunter and can take the Bite action.

grommoth.name: Grommoth

**Placid.** The grommoth won't move faster than a walk, or fight, unless its herd or its house is threatened.

sections.title: Actions

mirehorn.name: Mirehorn

sections.title: Traits
items: **Beast of Burden.** The mirehorn counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.
**Mud-Footed.** Mud, marsh, and shallow water aren't Difficult Terrain for the mirehorn, or for a cart it hauls.
**Wary of the Deep.** The mirehorn has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice a Large or larger creature moving in water within 300 feet of it.

items: **Gore.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. The mirehorn gores only when its herd, or the child it carries, is threatened.

notes: In the south it is called the wallow-ox. A wallow-ox is grey, nearly hairless, and has 59 (7d10 + 21) Hit Points.

oilfleece-sheep.name: Oilfleece Lamb

items: **Oilfleece.** The lamb is never soaked through, and it has Advantage on saving throws against Extreme Cold.

notes: A grown oilfleece sheep is Medium.

haulbeetle.name: Haulbeetle
mid: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 60 ft.; Passive Perception 9

sections.title: Traits
items: **Beast of Burden.** The beetle counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.
**Tunnel-Wise.** The beetle never gets lost underground on a route it has walked before.

notes: It makes no attacks.

lamp-shoal.name: Lamp-Shoal
lamp-shoal.meta: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, Unaligned
mid: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

sections.title: Traits
items: **Swarm.** The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny fish. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
**Water Breathing.** The shoal can breathe only underwater.
**Streetlight.** The shoal sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet, blue-green and gold.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Scatter-Flash (1/Day).** The shoal flares and breaks apart. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in the shoal's space. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

notes: The Coral peoples train them, and nobody keeps one.

reefpurple-whelk.name: Reefpurple Whelk

sections.title: Traits
items: **Water Breathing.** The whelk can breathe only underwater.
**Shell.** As a Bonus Action, the whelk withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, its AC is 17 and its Speed is 0.
**One Drop.** A whelk gives a single drop of reefpurple once in its life. Pressed before its time, it gives nothing.
**Purple Hands.** A creature that handles a whelk bare-handed is stained purple to the wrist for a month.

notes: A vial of reefpurple costs thirty Anchors, which is a great many whelks.

silverport-silkmoth.name: Silverport Silkmoth

sections.title: Traits
items: **Living Brooch.** The moth sits still on a shoulder or a collar for hours. Disturbed, it flies back to the same person.
**A Month of Wings.** A grown silkmoth doesn't eat, and lives about a month.

notes: The caterpillar is Tiny, has 1 Hit Point and a Speed of 5 feet, and spins about a thousand yards of thread into its cocoon.

momumba-lord-of-apes.name: Cohort Girallon
mid: None, but cohort girallons answer each other in a drummed code no Hunter has broken

sections.title: Traits
items: **Cohort Tactics.** The girallon has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the girallon's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

**The Lord's Plan.** A band of cohort girallons never all shows itself. Until one of them attacks, the ones still in the canopy have the Invisible condition to any creature that hasn't succeeded on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot them.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The girallon makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack.

**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Canopy Leap.** The girallon jumps up to 30 feet to a branch, ledge, or wall it can see, without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

notes: *Harvest:* four great canines (10 Anchors each through a Lodge); a cohort pelt (30 Anchors).
Momumba's cohort, the most tactical brood of any Lord. A band of six sends two to be seen while four wait above. The tribes pay Momumba tribute so that his cohort will hunt somewhere else.

**Flyby.** The thunderbird doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The thunderbird makes one Talons attack and one Beak attack.

**Talons.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16), and the thunderbird can fly off with it.
**Beak.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage.

**Call the Bolt (Recharge 5–6).** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point the thunderbird can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 27 (6d8) Lightning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

notes: *Harvest:* storm-feathers (5 Anchors each, a dozen to a bird; fletchers and Tidecallers both buy); a thunder-gizzard stone (80 Anchors).
Badron's lesser get, scattered across the high airs. Where one hunts, storms follow it; sailors who see the shadow of one on the water reef their sails before the sky changes.

**The Thunder-Regent.** The eldest of Badron's get, which rules the low weather while she sleeps. Galven crews dip their colors when it passes, and no Lodge has ever posted a contract on it, because a contract on the Regent is a contract on Badron's temper. To run it, use the thunderbird with these changes: it is Huge, it has three times the Hit Points, its Call the Bolt recharges on a 4 to 6, and it has Legendary Resistance (3/Day). It is a fight for Gold Hunters, and a story for everyone else.

shakarr-the-shadow-of-death.name: Quietfang

sections.title: Traits
items: **Silent.** The quietfang makes no sound at all. A creature can't use hearing to locate it, and it can't be heard even when it attacks.
**Shadow Stealth.** While in Dim Light or Darkness, the quietfang can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The quietfang makes two Rend attacks.

**Rend.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target has the Surprised or Incapacitated condition, this hit is a Critical Hit.

notes: *Harvest:* a shadow-pelt that drinks lamplight (120 Anchors; cloak-makers to the Undertow); nothing else, because the body fades by dawn.

The lesser shadow-things that seep from the Bonewilds' dark. They leave Shakarr's signature: a perfect kill, no struggle, no tracks. The natives do not name them aloud, and Hunters call them quietfangs only in a lit room.

kayuntu-the-violent-monarch-of-the-five-.name: Skyband Wyvern

sections.title: Traits
items: **Holder of the Band.** Each skyband wyvern claims a band of sky a few hundred feet deep. It has Advantage on attack rolls against any flying creature, and it never willingly leaves its band to pursue one.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The wyvern makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
**Sting.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

notes: *Harvest:* a sting-bladder (60 Anchors; apothecaries and poisoners); wing-leather (40 Anchors).
Kayuntu's lesser wyverns of the upper airs. The Aethyn chart their bands each season with the Watch of the Five, because flying through a claimed band is how gliders and thermal-riders die.

kakankal-emperor-of-flames.name: Ember Lizard
top: 30 ft., Burrow 10 ft. (ash and cinder only), Climb 30 ft.

sections.title: Traits
items: **Ember-Blood.** A creature that hits the lizard with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The lizard makes two Bite attacks.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.
**Cinder Spit (Recharge 5–6).** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 21 (6d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

notes: *Harvest:* shed scales (2 Anchors a handful; smiths swear by them for flux); a vial of ember-blood that stays hot for a year (25 Anchors).
KakanKal's lesser fire-lizards, prized by smiths and held near-sacred by the Cindren, who will not sell ember-blood to anyone who did not ask the lizard first.

malim-the-laughing-flood.name: Flood Otter

sections.title: Traits
items: **Hold Breath.** The otter can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
**Malim's Games.** The otter has Advantage on ability checks to grapple or shove, and as an action it can overturn a boat of Large size or smaller that it is underneath.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The otter makes one Bite attack and one Tail Slap attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

**Tail Slap.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and the otter can drag it underwater as it moves.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Roll Away.** The otter takes the Disengage action.

notes: *Harvest:* a flood-otter pelt, waterproof and warm (50 Anchors).
Malim's lesser get, mischievous and deadly, infesting the larger rivers. They play. They do not know when to stop. River tribes tell their children to be kind to the water, because Malim is watching.

ssvayuk-the-mud-that-breathes.name: Bog-Serpent

sections.title: Traits
items: **False Island.** While the serpent is motionless and half-sunk in mud or water, it is indistinguishable from a reed-grown mud-bank.
**Hold Breath.** The serpent can hold its breath for 1 hour.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The serpent makes one Bite attack and one Constrict attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

**Constrict.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) and the Restrained condition while Grappled.

notes: *Harvest:* serpent-hide (90 Anchors; the lizardfolk will not buy it, and may ask where you got it).

The lesser bog-serpents that haunt Ssvayuk's margins. The lizardfolk call them the grandmother's children and leave them fish. Travelers who camp on dry ground in the great bogs should check that it is ground.

vukharr-the-white-hunger.name: Ribwalker

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Emptying.** Beasts with an Intelligence of 3 or lower flee the ribwalker's scent; for a mile around one, the land is empty of game.
**Starving Frenzy.** The ribwalker has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that is Bloodied.
**Snow Camouflage.** The ribwalker has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in snow or ice.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The ribwalker makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.
**Claw.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

notes: *Harvest:* white fur that never ices (70 Anchors); a rib-bow, if a Frost Elf will make one for you.
Vukharr's lesser white-hunger beasts, gaunt and ravenous, which herald the Lord by emptying the land. Frost Elf warbands paint their faces as a ribwalker's skull before a winter raid.

ulgrenn-the-hollow-song.name: Echo
mid: Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 14

sections.title: Traits
items: **Borrowed Voices.** The echo can mimic any voice or sound it has heard, perfectly. It can only repeat: it can't answer a question with anything it hasn't heard, and a creature that asks it such a question knows at once what it is.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The echo makes two Bite attacks.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

**Resonance (Recharge 5–6).** *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the echo. *Failure:* 14 (4d6) Thunder damage, and the creature has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

notes: *Harvest:* a resonance-bone that hums back any sound (35 Anchors; bell-founders and Sporrn both want them).
Ulgrenn's progeny, from the size of a dog to the size of a boat. An echo will call to you in your companion's voice from a side-tunnel. Ask it something only your companion knows.

ulgrenn-the-hollow-song.name: Great Echo
mid: Blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 15

sections.title: Traits
items: **Borrowed Voices.** As the echo, but it has swallowed whole caravans, and it speaks with all of them.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The great echo makes two Bite attacks.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

**The Hollow Song (Recharge 5–6).** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature within 120 feet that can hear the great echo. *Failure:* The creature has the Charmed condition for 1 minute, and on each of its turns it must use its movement to come toward the great echo by the safest route. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. *Success:* The creature is immune to this Song for 24 hours.

notes: *Harvest:* a song-throat, which the Sporrn will pay 300 Anchors to see destroyed.
The boat-sized echoes deep in the Calling Halls, where the Hollow Song is loudest. The Orka sealed their deepest ruins against the Lord that makes them.

thalgorath-the-tide-tyrant.name: Trench Horror
mid: Telepathy 120 ft., in the voices of the drowned

sections.title: Traits
items: **Abyssal.** The horror can breathe only water. Out of water, its Speed is 10 feet and it has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The horror makes three Tentacle attacks.

**Tentacle.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18), and the horror pulls it 10 feet closer and down.

**Drowning Dream (Recharge 5–6).** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature within 60 feet that the horror can see. *Failure:* 33 (6d10) Psychic damage, and the creature has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, certain that it is drowning. *Success:* Half damage only.

notes: *Harvest:* nothing the sea-peoples will let you keep; the Red Choir treats a dead trench horror as a holy relic.

The deep horrors of the abyssal trenches, Thalgorath's seep: lesser abyssal things that the sea-peoples themselves flee. When one rises, a Coral court sends word to its sea-pact ports, and the wise ones keep their boats ashore.

tyrakzhul-the-world-eater.name: First-Jaw Get

sections.title: Traits
items: **Siege Monster.** The get deals double damage to objects and structures.
**Eldersaur.** Every saurian that can see the get has the Frightened condition while it can see the get, unless it is an Eldersaur too.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The get makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 34 (4d12 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 21) and the Restrained condition while Grappled. The get can't Bite another creature while it has one Grappled.
**Tail.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is pushed 15 feet and has the Prone condition.

**The King's Roar (Recharge 5–6).** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature within 300 feet that can hear the get. *Failure:* The creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. *Success:* The creature is immune to this Roar for 24 hours.

notes: *Harvest:* a First-Jaw tooth (1,000 Anchors through a Lodge; more than that off the Ledger, and a Flenser's knife in the back for free).
Tyrak'Zhul's direct progeny: titanic theropods, Eldersaurs in their own right. A Gold contract, always. Jakupur does not train them, does not sell them, and does not let anyone else try.

swordtooth.name: Swordtooth (Azarox)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Pack Tactics.** The swordtooth has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the swordtooth's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
**Pounce.** If the swordtooth moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Bite, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The swordtooth makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.
**Claw.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

notes: Jakupur's war-mount and the backbone of saurian cavalry. A trained one costs 100 to 300 Anchors, double under the Sukuun mark. A wild pack is a death sentence.

dreadmaw.name: Dreadmaw (Tzharrok)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Breaks the Line.** When the dreadmaw moves through the space of a Large or smaller creature, that creature makes a DC 18 Strength saving throw or has the Prone condition.
**Siege Monster.** The dreadmaw deals double damage to objects and structures.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The dreadmaw makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18) and the Restrained condition while Grappled.
**Tail.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 20 (3d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.

notes: The apex war-beast, descended in the deepest sense from Tyrak'Zhul. Rare, ruinously expensive, dangerous to its own keepers; a single trained one can break a battle-line.

thornback.name: Thornback (Korzak)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Spiked Plates.** A creature that hits the thornback with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (2d4) Piercing damage.
**Living Wall.** Creatures directly behind the thornback, from an attacker's point of view, have Three-Quarters Cover.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Tail Club.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (4d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw or has the Prone condition.

notes: The living fortress: a mobile wall, a battering ram, a guardian. Its shed plates are worked into armor in Jakupur.

lashtail.name: Lashtail (Tzulak)

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The lashtail makes one Bite attack and one Lash attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.
**Lash.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is holding a nonmagical shield, the shield is broken.

**Sweep (Recharge 5–6).** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature within 15 feet of the lashtail. *Failure:* 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the creature has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

notes: The whip-tail of Jakupur's fighting pits. Temperamental, and a terror in trained hands.

swiftcrest.name: Swiftcrest (Sissix)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Racer.** The swiftcrest can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Kick.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

notes: The racer of the Great Track, and a couriers' and outriders' mount. From 150 Anchors for a plodder to 5,000 for a champion's bloodline.

glidetalon.name: Glidetalon (Vollun)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Glider.** The glidetalon can't gain height in flight except on a rising wind; it descends 1 foot for every 2 feet it flies.
**Scout's Mount.** A glidetalon can carry a Small rider.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Talons.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

notes: The scout of the air, carrying Small scouts and messages over rough country. Wild ones hunt in murders like winged jackals.

skyfin.name: Skyfin (Aetzox)

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The skyfin makes one Bite attack and one Talons attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
**Talons.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

notes: The true flyer of the south, nesting on high cliffs; the rare and coveted aerial mount. Its membrane is hunted for the rarest of constructions.

loamback.name: Loamback (Mokun)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Beast of Burden.** The loamback counts as Gargantuan for its carrying capacity and for what it can pull.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Stomp.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (3d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

notes: The great hauler, the south's plough-beast and construction-engine; Jakupur was built on its labor. About 100 Anchors trained to harness.

altisaur.name: Altisaur (Yaltox)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Living Platform.** An altisaur can carry a howdah with up to twenty Medium passengers, who have Half Cover against attacks from the ground.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Stomp.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Prone condition.
**Tail.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 23 (3d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.

notes: The colossus: the tallest of the domesticated saurians, used for the heaviest hauling, for raising great buildings, and as a living platform.

craghorn.name: Craghorn (Gormak)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Trampling Charge.** If the craghorn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Gore, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw or has the Prone condition.
**Stubborn.** The craghorn has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Gore.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

notes: The horned worker, strong as an ox and twice as stubborn. It hauls, it ploughs, and it gores the predator that comes too close.

murkstrider.name: Murkstrider (Marrox)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Swamp Stride.** Difficult Terrain made of mud, water, or bog doesn't cost the murkstrider extra movement.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Spear-Bill.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

notes: The wader, mount of the bog-tribes and the marsh-paths.

mirewallow.name: Mirewallow (Sszuka)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Hold Breath.** The mirewallow can hold its breath for 1 hour.
**Floating Island.** While motionless in water, it looks like a moss-grown island, often with birds on it.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 22 (3d10 + 6) Piercing damage.

**Roll (Recharge 5–6).** *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature on the mirewallow's back or within 10 feet of it. *Failure:* 28 (4d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the creature is pulled 10 feet underwater. *Success:* Half damage only.

sections.title: Reactions
items: **Startled.** *Trigger:* The mirewallow takes damage. *Response:* It moves up to its Swim Speed, and each creature in its path makes a DC 17 Strength saving throw or takes 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

notes: The bog-beast, kin (the lizardfolk say) to Ssvayuk. Harmless unless startled, then catastrophic.

razorfin.name: Razorfin (Razku)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Amphibious.** The razorfin can breathe air and water.
**Blood in the Water.** The razorfin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that is Bloodied.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The razorfin makes one Bite attack and one Fin attack.

**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and the razorfin can drag it under.
**Fin.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

notes: The river-killer, all jaws and speed; the terror of the Murkstrider routes. Rarely tamed and never trusted.

gloamhide.name: Gloamhide (Xolca)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Color-Shift.** While the gloamhide is in Dim Light or in foliage and hasn't moved since the start of its last turn, it has the Invisible condition.
**Ambusher.** The gloamhide has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet in the combat.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The gloamhide makes one Bite attack and two Rend attacks.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
**Rend.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

notes: The twilight stalker, so rare and so deadly that some doubt it exists. The White Flame keeps a standing bounty on wild ones; a trained one is a peerless hunting-beast.

twincrest.name: Twincrest (Keshix)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Pack Tactics.** The twincrest has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the twincrest's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
**Testing Bite.** The twincrest circles before it commits. If it hasn't attacked a creature yet in this fight, it has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from that creature.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Quick Turn.** The twincrest takes the Disengage action.

notes: A pair is worse than two: one holds your eye while the other comes from the side. Handlers keep them for hunting and for guarding walled grounds, and never feed them by hand.

songcrest.name: Songcrest (Saalix)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Herd-Call.** The songcrest's call carries up to a mile through woodland. Every songcrest that hears it knows where the caller is.
**Composed.** While it carries a rider, the songcrest has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Tail Swipe.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the songcrest.

notes: The south's mount for processions and gentle travel. A startled one swings its tail before it thinks, so riders give it room when the herd takes fright.

packthumb.name: Packthumb (Tammok)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Beast of Burden.** The packthumb counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity.
**Long Road.** The packthumb can travel for 12 hours a day before it risks Exhaustion from a forced march.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Thumb Spike.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

notes: Not every breed has the thumb-spikes. The ones that don't kick instead, for the same damage, as Bludgeoning. Approach where it can see you.

sections.title: Traits
items: **Placid.** The bellowback won't fight unless it's cornered or a calf of its herd is threatened.
**Bellow.** The bellowback's lowing can be heard 2 miles away. Every bellowback that hears it turns to face the sound.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Stomp.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

sections.title: Traits
items: **Flock-Fowl.** A cluckmaw that loses sight of its flock makes enough noise to be heard 300 feet away until it finds them again.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Peck.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1 Piercing damage.

quillhen.name: Quillhen (Pirrak)

sections.title: Traits
items: **Quills.** A creature that grapples the quillhen takes 2 (1d4) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Peck.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

notes: Its plumes are the south's writing quills and fletching. A quillhen plucked in anger keeps the grudge for a season.

giant-betta.name: Jewelfin

sections.title: Traits
items: **Gulps Air.** The jewelfin breathes water, and can also gulp air at the surface. Kept wet, it lives out of water for 1 hour.
**Territorial.** The jewelfin has Advantage on attack rolls against another jewelfin, and against any creature that entered its water within the last minute.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Display.** The jewelfin flares its fins and gill covers. One creature it can see within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of the jewelfin's next turn.

notes: One fish to a pool. Two in the same water fight until one is dead, which is the whole business of the clandestine pits.

red-choir.name: Red Choir Singer
mid: The Red Choir's tongue; understands Common

sections.title: Traits
items: **Blood Frenzy.** The singer has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that is Bloodied.
**Limited Amphibiousness.** The singer can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours or begin to suffocate.
**Blood in the Water.** When any creature within 300 feet of the singer takes damage in water, the singer and its allies within hearing gain 10 feet of Swim Speed until the end of their next turns.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The singer makes one Bite attack and one Trident attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
**Trident.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

**The Choir (Recharge 5–6).** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature of the singer's choice within 30 feet that can hear it. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the creature has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

notes: The Red Choir's priests. The Choir sings when blood is in the water, and Thalgorath is its choirmaster. Its warriors use the sahuagin of the 2024 Monster Manual.

king-tide.name: Lane Serpent

sections.title: Traits
items: **Hold Breath.** The serpent can hold its breath for 1 hour.
**Ship-Breaker.** The serpent's attacks ignore a ship's Damage Threshold (Seafaring, Part Two) and deal double damage to ships and other objects.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The serpent makes one Bite attack and one Crush attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage.

**Crush.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) and the Restrained condition while Grappled.

notes: *Harvest:* serpent-ivory (400 Anchors), a hide that sheathes a hull (600 Anchors); the Killing Tide pays a bounty on every head.
The great serpents that cross the southern lanes in Storm Water. The Killing Tide hunts them on the King Tide's Three Nights, when they come up.

grey-fathoms.name: Fathom-Kept

sections.title: Traits
items: **Amphibious.** The fathom-kept can breathe air and water, though it does not need to breathe.
**The Water's Weight.** A creature Grappled by the fathom-kept underwater can't hold its breath.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The fathom-kept makes two Clutch attacks.
**Clutch.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Cold damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).

notes: The kept drowned of the Grey Fathoms, who ransom the dead back to a sea-pact port. A fathom-kept that rises to fight is either guarding something or has been sent; to destroy one is to break a sea-pact with the court that keeps it.

below.name: Lightdrinker Swarm
below.meta: Large Swarm of Tiny Beasts, Unaligned
mid: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

sections.title: Traits
items: **Swarm.** The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
**Drink the Light.** At the start of each of the swarm's turns, every nonmagical flame or light within 10 feet of it goes out, and any light created by a spell of level 2 or lower in its space ends.
**Moth to Flame.** The swarm always moves toward the brightest light it can perceive, including a drow's eye-light.
**Harmless to Flesh.** The swarm has no attacks.

notes: Pale moths with a gull's wingspan. A swarm on a lantern puts it out in a breath. Most deaths Below begin with the lamp going out.

below.name: Pale Spinner, Wild
mid: Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 10

sections.title: Traits
items: **Spider Climb.** The spinner can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without an ability check.
**Web Sense.** While in contact with a web, the spinner knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

**Darksilk (Recharge 5–6).** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, one creature the spinner can sense within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition until it or someone else uses an action to tear free with a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check.

notes: The drow's silk-spiders are shy, blind, and as big as dogs. The wild ones of the Old Cut are less shy. A tame spinner has no Bite worth the name and will not leave its herd.

below.name: Pale Crab
mid: Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 9

sections.title: Traits
items: **Amphibious.** The crab can breathe air and water.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The crab makes two Claw attacks.

**Claw.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of the crab's two claws.

notes: Blind, white, as wide as a cart-wheel, picking over the wet miles for whatever the tide left. It does not care whether what the tide left is still alive.

drow.name: Drow Light-Thief

sections.title: Traits
items: **Fey Ancestry.** The drow has Advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the Charmed condition, and magic can't put it to sleep.

**Veiled.** In sunlight the drow wears a gauze veil over its eyes. While veiled, it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. Unveiled in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The drow makes two attacks, using Black-Glass Blade or Black-Glass Arrow in any combination.
**Black-Glass Blade.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
**Black-Glass Arrow.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Snuff.** The drow puts out one nonmagical flame or light it can see within 30 feet: a candle, torch, lamp, or lantern. If a creature is holding the light, that creature can make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw to shield it.

notes: A raid is six to twenty of them. They carry off their own dead, and every light in the place.

drow.name: Drow Raid-Leader

sections.title: Traits
items: **Fey Ancestry.** The drow has Advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the Charmed condition, and magic can't put it to sleep.

**Veiled.** In sunlight the drow wears a gauze veil over its eyes. While veiled, it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. Unveiled in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls.
**As One.** Each drow ally within 30 feet of the raid-leader that can see or hear it can't have the Frightened condition.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The raid-leader makes three attacks, using Black-Glass Blade or Black-Glass Arrow in any combination.
**Black-Glass Blade.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
**Black-Glass Arrow.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

**Spellcasting.** The raid-leader casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12): **1/Day each:** *Darkness*, *Faerie Fire*.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Snuff.** As the Drow Light-Thief's, with a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw.

notes: Nobody has seen a drow break ranks, argue, or run. A cornered one fights until it is dead.

daemons.name: Mask-Bearer
mid: Common, and the daemon's voice, which speaks through the mask

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Mask.** The mask can't be removed while the bearer lives. A creature that touches it bare-handed must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or hear the daemon's offer, which is exactly what that creature wants.
**Used Up.** Each time the bearer uses Borrowed Power, it takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage that can't be reduced in any way.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The bearer makes two Masked Blow attacks.
**Masked Blow.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

**Borrowed Power (Recharge 5–6).** The daemon looks out through the mask. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the bearer. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

notes: Power runs through the mask into the wearer, and something of the wearer runs back. What is left at the end is the daemon's.

daemons.name: Rift-Born
mid: understands the tongue of whoever opened its door, but doesn't speak

sections.title: Traits
items: **Doorbound.** The rift-born can't go more than 1 mile from the rift it came through. If that rift is sealed, the rift-born has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws, and it loses 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns until it is destroyed or another door opens to it.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The rift-born makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage.
**Claw.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

notes: What comes through a torn place when nobody shuts it. The Sacred Flame burns them, and writes down where they came from.

the-warped.name: Warped Goblin

sections.title: Traits
items: **Collector's Eye.** The goblin has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature that owes it a debt.
**Late Shadow.** The goblin's shadow arrives a moment after it does. It has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in Dim Light or Darkness.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Hooked Knife.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Nimble Escape.** The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

notes: Anything you take from one is a loan, whether a price was named or not.

the-warped.name: Warped Tallyman
mid: Common, Goblin, Sylvan, and any language spoken by a creature that owes it a debt

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Tally.** The tallyman knows the name of every creature that owes it a debt, and the direction to each of them while they are on the same plane.
**Letter of the Bargain.** The tallyman knows when a creature it can hear breaks the terms of a bargain made in its presence.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The tallyman makes two Tally-Rod attacks, or it makes one Tally-Rod attack and uses Call the Debt.
**Tally-Rod.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

**Call the Debt.** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature the tallyman can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. If the target owes the tallyman a debt, it also has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

**Spellcasting.** The tallyman casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): **At will:** *Thaumaturgy*. **1/Day each:** *Bestow Curse*, *Hold Person*.

notes: A priest of the Owed Mouth. Its oldest debt is written on its skin.

the-warped.name: Warped Collector

sections.title: Traits
items: **Quieter Than It Should Be.** The collector makes no sound when it moves, and it has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
**Surprise Attack.** If the collector hits a creature that has the Surprised condition, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The collector makes two Grab-Hook attacks.
**Grab-Hook.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14).

notes: The bugbears of the Warped. When one crosses the Veil, it has come to collect.

dream-eaters.name: Lull
mid: Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained

sections.title: Traits
items: **Dream-Bound.** The Lull exists only in the Roam. It can't pass under the Dome at Halfwake or cross a line of Roam-salt.
**The Quiet.** Within 30 feet of the Lull, sound goes dull. Creatures there have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
**Lone Prey.** The Lull won't come within 30 feet of three or more creatures that are together.
**Waking.** A creature that wakes is gone from the Lull's reach. Any effect the Lull has on it ends.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The Lull uses Lure and Unmake.

**Lure.** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature the Lull can sense within 120 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition and must use its movement to come toward the Lull by the shortest route. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

**Unmake.** *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 5 feet of the Lull. *Failure:* 22 (4d10) Psychic damage. If this reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is eaten: it wakes at once in its own bed, whole, and never sleeps again. *Success:* Half damage only.

notes: A missing color, a stair that folds the wrong way, a hole the shape of a tune. The first sign of one is that the dream goes quiet.

dream-eaters.name: The Greyed

sections.title: Traits
items: **Sleepless.** The Grey doesn't sleep and can't be put to sleep.
**Nothing Left.** The Grey shows no fear, pain, or anger. Wisdom (Insight) checks to read it have Disadvantage, and veil butterflies won't land on it.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The Grey makes two Strike attacks.
**Strike.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

notes: Most of the Greyed are no danger to anyone. This is the one that stopped minding.

storm-listeners.name: Stormchanter

sections.title: Traits
items: **Sky-Listener.** The stormchanter knows the weather of the next 24 hours for 10 miles around, and it can't be surprised while it can hear the wind.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The stormchanter makes two Storm-Staff attacks, or it makes one Storm-Staff attack and one Lightning Lash attack.
**Storm-Staff.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Lightning damage.
**Lightning Lash.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 16 (3d10) Lightning damage.

**Call the Storm (Recharge 5–6).** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder within 120 feet. *Failure:* 27 (6d8) Lightning damage. *Success:* Half damage. A ship in the Cylinder takes the damage too, ignoring its Damage Threshold.

notes: They teach children to sit through a change of wind before they ask the skies anything.

changelings.name: Changeling
mid: Common, Sylvan, and every language its lender speaks

sections.title: Traits
items: **Lent Face.** The changeling wears the face, voice, and memories of a living creature that lent them. A creature that knew the lender well can see through it with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check: it knows every fact and none of the smells.
**Eyes Meet.** If the lender and the changeling meet each other's eyes, the face goes home at once, and the changeling shows its own until it is lent another.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The changeling makes two Glass Knife attacks.
**Glass Knife.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

**Spellcasting.** The changeling casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): **At will:** *Minor Illusion*. **1/Day each:** *Charm Person*, *Invisibility*.

notes: Most are on a Court's errand. Being one is no crime in the islands.

gnoll-warbands.name: Gnoll Raider

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Hunger.** When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, or sees another gnoll of its band begin to change, it makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the Hunger takes it for 1 minute: it has Advantage on Bite attacks, it can't take the Disengage action, and when no enemy is within its reach it attacks the nearest creature, friend or not.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The gnoll makes one Spear attack and one Bite attack.
**Spear.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

notes: Unsworn raiders have no Hunger trait. They watch their own for its signs instead.

gnoll-warbands.name: Flint
mid: Common; understands Abyssal but can't speak it

sections.title: Traits
items: **Through the Hunger.** The Flint came out of the Hunger changed. It can't be taken by it again, and gnolls of its band within 30 feet of it have Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.
**Visions.** The Flint sees places it has never been. Its band goes where the visions say.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The Flint makes one Bite attack and two Rend attacks.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
**Rend.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Wake the Hunger (Recharge 5–6).** Each gnoll of the Flint's choice within 30 feet that can hear it is taken by the Hunger, with no saving throw.

notes: The rare few who survive the Hunger come out larger and stronger, with the old pact in their dreams. Among the Sworn, a Flint leads, or preaches, or both.

ironfang-warband.name: Ironfang

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Hunger.** When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, or sees another gnoll of its band begin to change, it can choose to fail a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw, and Ironfangs usually do. Then the Hunger takes it for 1 minute: it has Advantage on Bite attacks, it can't take the Disengage action, and when no enemy is within its reach it attacks the nearest creature, friend or not.
**Iron in the Mouth.** The Ironfang's broken teeth are capped with iron. Its Bite is a d8, not a d4.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The Ironfang makes one Bite attack and one Flail attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
**Flail.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

notes: Their chiefs wear the iron caps of the chiefs before them on a cord, and give them up only to a successor who has survived the Hunger.

bonewatchers.name: Bonewatcher

sections.title: Traits
items: **Night Watch.** The bonewatcher can't be surprised, and it has Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to notice the first signs of the Hunger in another creature.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The bonewatcher makes two attacks, using Spear or Longbow in any combination.
**Spear.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
**Longbow.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

notes: Unsworn. A chief may take salt or a ransom and guarantee safe passage to the next well, and the sentries remember who paid.

ashmaws.name: Ashmaw Devotee

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Hunger.** When the gnoll reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, or sees another gnoll of its band begin to change, it makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the Hunger takes it for 1 minute: it has Advantage on Bite attacks, it can't take the Disengage action, and when no enemy is within its reach it attacks the nearest creature, friend or not.
**Called by Name.** The devotee has Advantage on attack rolls against the one creature its Flint named before the raid.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The devotee makes one Bite attack and one Handaxe attack.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
**Handaxe.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

notes: Ash from the fires of earlier raids, rubbed into the muzzle before the march.

redjaws.name: Redjaw Corsair

sections.title: Traits
items: **Deck-Footed.** The corsair ignores difficult terrain on a deck or in rigging, and it has Advantage on saving throws against the Prone condition aboard a ship.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The corsair makes two attacks, using Boarding Hook or Bite in any combination.
**Boarding Hook.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the corsair can pull it up to 10 feet closer.
**Bite.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

notes: Unsworn raiders who learned to sail. Their chief returns captives once the ransom is paid; settlements that refuse find their ferryboats gone.

orc-tribes.name: Orc Raider of the Southern Tribes

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Telling.** While the orc can hear a war leader recite the names of the tribe's dead, it has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

sections.title: Actions
items: **War-Axe.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
**Javelin.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Aggressive.** The raider moves up to its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

embertusks.name: Embertusk Coal-Bearer

sections.title: Traits
items: **The Telling.** While the orc can hear a war leader recite the names of the tribe's dead, it has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The coal-bearer makes two Maul attacks.
**Maul.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

**Throw the Coals (Recharge 6).** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 30 feet. *Failure:* 10 (3d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

notes: Before demanding tribute, a war leader sets a pot of the shrine's coals at the foot of the gate, and the fighters wait while it smokes.

reedskulls.name: Reedskull Crossing-Warden

sections.title: Traits
items: **Hold Breath.** The warden can hold its breath for 10 minutes.
**Reed-Hidden.** The warden has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in reeds, marsh, or shallow water.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The warden makes two Harpoon attacks.

**Harpoon.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and while it is in water the warden can pull it under.

notes: They take tribute in nails, tools, and blades, and argue over how much to forge and how much to sink at the drowned mound.

kohr-imperium.name: Iron Host Veteran

sections.title: Traits
items: **Weakness Is a Choice.** The veteran has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition, and it can't be Frightened while it can see another Inheritor.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The veteran makes two Longsword attacks, or one Musket attack.
**Longsword.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
**Musket.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 40/120 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d12 + 1) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Reactions
items: **Close the Line.** *Trigger:* An ally within 5 feet of the veteran is hit by an attack. *Response:* The veteran makes one Longsword attack against the attacker, if it is within reach.

notes: There is no word for retreat in Kohrane. A veteran's Host has a number, not a name.

kohr-imperium.name: Inquisitor of the Iron Sun

sections.title: Traits
items: **Unshakable Faith.** The inquisitor has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The inquisitor makes two Krysta-Forged Blade attacks, or one Krysta-Forged Blade attack and one Pistol attack.
**Krysta-Forged Blade.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.
**Pistol.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

**Verdict (Recharge 5–6).** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature the inquisitor can see within 30 feet that can hear it. A creature that is not human has Disadvantage on the save. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, and its Speed is 0 while it is Frightened. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

notes: An inquisitor's name has Sol before it. The night before it takes someone, its cell drives a gilded nail into the door.

kohr-imperium.name: Gilded Scale

sections.title: Traits
items: **Sworn to Ghral.** The Scale has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed condition.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The Scale makes two Glaive attacks.
**Glaive.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
**Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6).** *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (5d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

sections.title: Reactions
items: **Gilded Guard.** *Trigger:* A creature the Scale can see makes an attack roll against an ally within 5 feet of the Scale. *Response:* The Scale imposes Disadvantage on the attack roll.

notes: A deserter has stitch-marks where the gold insignia was, and no Sworn to Ghral trait. The recall teams know the stitch-marks.

kohr-imperium.name: Survey Envoy

sections.title: Traits
items: **Perfect Courtesy.** Wisdom (Insight) checks made to read the envoy's intentions have Disadvantage, and the envoy reveals nothing it does not mean to unless it is magically compelled.
**Never Forgets a Name.** The envoy remembers every name it has heard, and the face that went with it.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Courtier's Blade.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

**Measured Offer.** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 30 feet that can hear the envoy. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition for 1 hour, or until the envoy or its allies harm it.

notes: An envoy never eats what it is served. Everything it signs under the Sun's seal, it keeps.

house-wingate.name: Wingate Sellsword

sections.title: Traits
items: **Front-Hardened.** The sellsword has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

**Close Order.** While another Wingate within 5 feet of the sellsword doesn't have the Incapacitated condition, the sellsword has a +1 bonus to its Armor Class. A Wingate line fights two ranks deep: the second rank's halberds reach past the first.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The sellsword makes two attacks, using Halberd or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.
**Halberd.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d12 + 3) Slashing damage.
**Heavy Crossbow.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Reactions
items: **Parry.** The sellsword adds 2 to its Armor Class against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be holding a melee weapon.

notes: A Wingate company is not hired. It agrees to be.

house-wingate.name: Wingate Boarder

sections.title: Traits
items: **Sea Legs.** The boarder can't be knocked Prone by the motion of a ship, and has Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to keep its footing or to climb rigging.

**Boarding Rush.** If the boarder moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Cutlass attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Slashing damage. The boarder can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The boarder makes two attacks, using Cutlass or Throwing Knife in any combination.
**Cutlass.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
**Throwing Knife.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Swing Aboard.** The boarder moves up to its Speed by rope, rigging, or grapnel line, and its movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

notes: Wingate boarders go over the rail first, and the rest of the deck follows.

house-wingate.name: Wingate Captain

sections.title: Traits
items: **Front-Hardened.** The captain has Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.
**The Company.** Each Wingate ally within 30 feet of the captain that can see or hear it can't have the Frightened condition.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The captain makes three attacks, using Longsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.
**Longsword.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage if used with two hands.
**Heavy Crossbow.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Orders.** One Wingate ally within 30 feet that can hear the captain can take a Reaction to make one weapon attack.

sections.title: Reactions
items: **Parry.** The captain adds 3 to its Armor Class against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be holding a melee weapon.

notes: A Wingate captain has buried more of the family's people than most houses have ever hired, and remembers every name.

house-wingate.name: Wingate War-Brig
fields: 30 to 110 (sailors who fight, and soldiers who sail)
2 batteries of light guns per side; a long gun in the bow; four swivel guns
traits: **Wingate Crew.** Its crew is Veteran (+4), and losing hands never drops it below Blooded. On the rest of the deck it gains +1 for every full ten hands it has more than the other side, not every twenty.
notes: A brig built for the Front, carrying soldiers as much as cargo.

reckoners-hall.name: Counting Guard

sections.title: Traits
items: **Doorwarden.** The guard has Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to tell whether someone has business in the Hall, and on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice a concealed weapon.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** The guard makes two attacks with its Truncheon.
**Truncheon.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
**Light Crossbow.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Reactions
items: **Seize.** When a creature within 5 feet of the guard moves away from it, the guard grabs at it. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The creature has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) and stops moving.

notes: A raised voice in the Quiet Room costs one Tide. The Counting Guard collects it, and writes it down.

reckoners-hall.name: Wreck-Clerk

sections.title: Traits
items: **Hold Breath.** The clerk can hold its breath for 10 minutes.
**Reads a Wreck.** After 10 minutes aboard or beside a wreck, the clerk knows whether it went down to weather, fire, a fight, or somebody's hand, and roughly when.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Hook Knife.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
**Hand Crossbow.** *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **Back Off.** The clerk takes the Disengage action.

notes: Captains call them the Hall's crows: they turn up wherever a ship has gone down. They hire Hunters to go where they can't.

azhani.name: Azhani Emberstep
mid: Acrobatics +6, Deception +6, Insight +4, Performance +8, Persuasion +6, Sleight of Hand +6, Stealth +6

sections.title: Traits
items: **Emberstep.** Azhani's bare feet take no harm from anything they stand on. She ignores damage and Difficult Terrain that come only from what is underfoot: embers, ice, broken glass, caltrops, hot sand. It guards her feet, and nothing else.
**Kneels to No One.** Azhani has Advantage on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions, and on any check or saving throw to avoid or end the Prone condition.
**Dancer's Footing.** Azhani can't be knocked Prone by the motion of a ship, and she can move along a rail, a rope, or a ledge no wider than her foot at her full Speed without a check.

sections.title: Actions
items: **Multiattack.** Azhani makes two attacks, using Coin Sash or Dagger in any combination.
**Coin Sash.** *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, Azhani can pull it up to 5 feet straight toward her.
**Dagger.** *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

**The Ember Dance (Recharge 5–6).** *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature of Azhani's choice within 30 feet of her that can see her. *Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of Azhani's next turn, and can do nothing but watch her. The condition ends early on a target that takes damage. *Success:* The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

sections.title: Bonus Actions
items: **The Turn.** Azhani moves up to half her Speed, and her movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

sections.title: Reactions
items: **Spin Away.** Azhani halves the damage of one attack that hits her. To do so, she must see the attacker.

notes: She will bow to an audience from the waist, and to nobody lower.

travel.name: Southern River Canoe
fields: −6 (it is not meant for open sea)
traits: **River-Born.** It can be carried around a fall or a rapid by its own crew.

travel.name: Coastal Trader (one mast)
fields: two swivel guns; sometimes a light gun on each side

travel.name: Ocean Merchantman (three masts)
fields: 1 battery of light guns per side; two swivel guns

travel.name: Pirate Brigantine
fields: 2 batteries of light guns per side; four swivel guns
traits: **Built to Run.** It gains a +2 bonus to chase rolls.

travel.name: Whaler (the ice)
traits: **Ice-Strakes.** A doubled hull; the ship has Advantage on seaworthiness checks in ice and sea-ice.

free-tide.name: Pirate Brigantine
fields: 2 batteries of light guns per side; four swivel guns
traits: **Built to Run.** It gains a +2 bonus to chase rolls.

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Harbinger (cutter)
fields: 1 battery of light guns per side; two swivel guns
traits: **Dispatch Rider.** A Harbinger gains a +4 bonus to chase rolls.
notes: Courier. “A Harbinger means news, and news is rarely good.”

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Vindicator (sloop)
fields: 2 batteries of light guns per side; a long gun in the bow (bow chaser)
traits: **Bow Chaser.** It can fire its bow gun at a ship it is chasing, ahead of it.
notes: Pursuit.

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Justicar (river gunboat)
fields: 50 miles on a river, 40 at sea
2 carronades fore and aft, turning to either side; four swivel guns
traits: **Shallow Draft.** It can go where a seagoing ship would run aground.
notes: The Emerald Wrath’s workhorse.

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Warden (frigate)
fields: 4 batteries of long guns per side; 4 swivel guns
notes: The backbone.

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Juggernaut (heavy frigate)
fields: 5 batteries of long guns per side
traits: **Storm-Runner.** It has Advantage on seaworthiness checks, and a gale does not halve its pace.
notes: Storm-runner, Galven-crewed.

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Interdictor (cruiser)
fields: 6 batteries of long guns per side; 2 carronades fore
traits: **Line of Fire.** Once per round, when a ship comes within 600 feet of it, it can fire one battery at that ship as a reaction.
notes: Blockade and area denial; the Iron Blockade’s fist.

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Dreadnought (ship of the line)
fields: 8 batteries of long guns per side; 4 carronades
notes: “Fears nothing.”

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Enforcer (bombard)
fields: 4 bombard mortars; 2 batteries of light guns per side
traits: **Siege-Ship.** Its mortars deal double damage to buildings and fortifications.
notes: Delivers the Council’s verdict to fortresses.

ship-classes-of-the-armada.name: Executioner (man-o-war)
fields: 10 batteries of long guns per side; 6 carronades; some carry a Krysta cannon
20,000 Orsals and a decade of Council argument
traits: **Flag of the Fleet.** Every allied ship within a mile that can see its flag adds 1 to its crew-quality bonus.
notes: Nine built; the great battle-flagships.

titania-and-the-iron-swan.name: The Iron Swan
fields: 40 ft., in any wind or none, and against the tide
90 miles, whatever the weather short of a storm
a crew of living flame; no one has counted them
unknown; ships that have fired on her have not said
traits: **No Sails.** Wind, calm, and gale do not affect its Speed or travel pace.
**Burning Wake.** Water within 30 feet of its hull boils at full steam. A creature that starts its turn in that water takes 11 (2d10) Fire damage.
**Iron.** It is immune to Fire damage, and ramming it is a very poor idea.
notes: The only steamship in the world, captained by Titania, Gold Hunter, eleventh in the Ranking.
